name: Orbit
description: A multiplayer text game in a shared simulation: a space station orbiting the Earth is its hub, and other worlds (the Moon, a red planet, an ice moon, an asteroid bazaar, a fantasy realm, a neon city) are a Gate, a ferry or your own starship away. Walk its three decks by compass, chat in the Cantina, talk to the residents who live there, look down at the real Earth from the Observation Deck, work your job, grow real-time crops in your own plots, mine the Asteroid Belt, shop on the Mall Ring, trade with other players, try the casino, raise a pet, start a family, celebrate a wedding, and climb the ranks and leaderboards. Played in English, in its window or from Aruna, typed or spoken: "orbit north", "orbit say hello", "orbit daily", "orbit status". Everyone, you included, speaks in a voice of their own (Hariku Voice), with recorded and generated sounds from the side things happen on, and quiet ambience. Connects only when you play; the server keeps your character (name, job, description, credits, things, progress, what the residents remember of you, your pets, family and weddings) and a hash of a secret made on your computer, and passes chat on without storing it. Credits are only for playing: no real money.
author: Rafli
